info.title: Keystone API
info.description: Community platform API. All errors are RFC 7807 problem+json. Authenticated endpoints take `Authorization: Bearer <access-token>`; refresh/auth cookies are httpOnly SameSite=Strict and never read by JS.

put.summary: Vote on an answer (-1, 0 to remove, +1). One vote per user.

get.summary:
Public question read — the grading key is never selected.
Fetch an assessment with its questions.
The caller's attempts on an assessment.

post.summary: Start an attempt on an assessment (returns the attempt + questions).
Submit an attempt for auto-grading.

Change the caller's password. Requires the current password (proof of
control), then atomically swaps the hash and revokes every OTHER session —
stolen-session tokens for the same account die on password change.

401.description: Missing/invalid token or wrong current password

post.summary:
Start a password reset. Same anti-enumeration posture as login: the
response is identical whether or not the account exists. In dev the raw
token is returned (mailer milestone emails it); only the hash is stored.

200.description: Reset token issued (dev: returned in body)

post.summary:
Authenticate with email + password. Sets the httpOnly refresh cookie and
returns the access token. Errors are deliberately generic (no enumeration).
Revoke the refresh session family and clear the refresh cookie.

Rotate the refresh session and return a fresh token pair. The old session
is revoked; replaying it revokes the whole family (reuse detection).

401.description: Missing/invalid refresh cookie, or reuse detected

post.summary:
Register a new account. Returns tokens plus a verification email token
(dev flow: the raw token is returned; the mailer milestone emails it).

Complete a password reset: validates the token, then swaps the hash and
burns the token atomically. Locked accounts are unlocked on success.

400.description: Invalid or expired token / weak password

get.summary:
List the authenticated user's live sessions; the one matching the current
refresh cookie is marked `current`.

delete.summary:
Revoke all live sessions for the authenticated user.
Revoke all live sessions for the current user.

Revoke one session. Ownership is enforced: another user's session id
answers 404, never revealing its existence.
Revoke one session. Ownership enforced: another user's session id 404s.

404.description: Session not found or not owned by the user

post.summary: Confirm the email verification token.
Award a bounty to an answer. Question author only; one award per bounty.
Create a career path.

get.summary: Fetch a career path with its steps.

post.summary: Add a step to a career path.

delete.summary: Delete a comment. Owner or staff only.

403.description: Not the author and not staff

post.summary: Create a community. The creator becomes the owner.
Join a community.

delete.summary: Leave a community.

patch.summary: Change a member's role. Community staff only.

post.summary: Attach an existing post to a community.

delete.summary: Remove a post from a community. Community staff only.

post.summary: Pin a post to the top of a community. Community staff only.

delete.summary: Unpin a post. Community staff only.

post.summary: Create (or fetch) a direct-message conversation with another user.

REST write path — identical semantics to the WS path (persist first, then
fan out), so clients without a socket can still participate.
Send a message to a conversation (fans out over websockets).

get.summary: Online presence for a conversation's participants.

post.summary: Mark a conversation read by the caller.
Create a course (draft). The creator is the author.

get.summary: Fetch a course by slug with its module tree.

post.summary: Create an assessment for a course. Author only.
Add a question to an assessment. Author only.
Enroll the caller in a course.
Mark a lesson complete for the caller (updates progress).
Add a module to a course. Author only.
Add a lesson to a module. Author only.

get.summary: The caller's progress in a course.

post.summary:
Publish — the course author or platform staff.
Publish a course. Author only.
Create an event. The creator becomes the organizer.

get.summary: Fetch an event by slug with capacity and waitlist state.

post.summary: Register for an event (or join its waitlist when full).

delete.summary: Cancel an event registration (promotes from the waitlist).

post.summary: Add a speaker to an event. Organizer only.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/files` — cursor-paged listing of the caller's files.
The caller's registered files (paged).

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/files` — register metadata after the bytes are in the bucket.
Atomic quota enforcement + image thumbnail generation.
Register an uploaded object (after the presigned PUT succeeds).

`POST /api/v1/files/presign` — mint a server-keyed PUT url.
Get a presigned PUT URL for a direct-to-storage upload.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/files/{id}` — metadata + a fresh presigned download url.
Owner or public file; anyone else gets a 404 (existence is never
confirmed to non-owners).
Fetch a file record (owner or staff only).

403.description: Not the owner and not staff
Not the owner and not staff

post.summary: Submit a self-assessment against a career step.

get.summary: List the current user's bookmarked posts.

post.summary:
Redeem credits — double-spend-safe at the repo (SERIALIZABLE).
Redeem credits for a reward.
Add an education entry to the caller's profile.

delete.summary: Remove an education entry. Owner only.

post.summary: Add a work experience entry to the caller's profile.

delete.summary: Remove a work experience entry. Owner only.

put.summary: Set (or clear) the caller's mentor profile.
Add a skill to the caller's profile.

delete.summary: Remove a skill. Owner only.

post.summary: Accept a mentorship request. Mentor only.
Decline a mentorship request. Mentor only.
Schedule a session on an accepted mentorship. Mentor only.
Resolve a report with a moderation action. Staff only.

get.description:
Gap recovery: send `Last-Event-ID: <notification-id>`; everything newer is
replayed from the database before the live stream chains on.
Server-Sent Events stream of the caller's notifications.

post.summary: Mark notifications read (by id, or all when ids are empty).
Create an organization. The creator becomes the owner.
Create a compliance alert for an organization. Org admin/owner only.
Resolve a compliance alert. Org admin/owner only.

File an org claim. The claimant must already be a member (prevents
drive-by domain takeover attempts on orgs you have no stake in). Only
the token HASH is persisted.
File a domain claim on an organization. Requires a matching DNS TXT
record (verification step below).

Verify a claim with the token. The token is hashed before comparison.
Verify a domain claim (checks the DNS TXT record).
Join an organization.

delete.summary: Leave an organization.

patch.summary:
Role changes require the org owner. Ownership transfer demotes the old
owner atomically (repo-level invariant).
Change an organization member's role. Org staff only.

get.summary: List an organization's verified vendor listings.

post.summary:
Manage (create) vendor listings — org admins/owners only.
Add a vendor listing to an organization. Org admin/owner only.

delete.summary: Remove a vendor listing. Org admin/owner only.

post.summary: Verify a vendor listing. Org admin/owner only.

get.summary: List posts with keyset pagination (before cursor from `next_cursor`).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Keyset cursor from the previous page

post.summary: Create a post (article / post / question / poll / discussion).

get.summary:
Fetch a post by slug or UUID. Unlisted/private posts require the author
or staff.

200.description: Post with author, tags and stats

404.description: Post not found or not visible

delete.summary: Soft-delete a post. Owner or staff only.

403.description: Not the author and not staff

patch.summary: Update a post. Owner or staff only; every edit writes a version row.

403.description: Not the author and not staff

get.summary: List answers for a question (accepted first, then by votes).

post.summary: Answer a question.
Accept an answer. Question author or staff only.

put.summary: Bookmark a post for the current user.

delete.summary: Remove a bookmark.

get.summary: Current bounty state for a question.

post.summary: Open a bounty on a question. Question author only.
Add a comment to a post (threaded via `parent_id`). Locked posts refuse.
Lock a post (refuses new comments). Author or staff only.

403.description: Not the author and not staff

delete.summary: Unlock a post. Author or staff only.

403.description: Not the author and not staff

get.summary: Poll state for a post (options + tallies + caller vote).

post.summary: Add an option to a poll. Post author only.

put.summary: Cast (or change) the caller's poll vote.

delete.summary: Remove the caller's poll vote.

put.summary: Set (upsert) a reaction on a post.

delete.summary: Remove the caller's reaction from a post.

get.summary: Related reading for a post — posts sharing tags, ranked by overlap.
List a post's edit history (survives soft delete; owner or staff only).

403.description: Not the author and not staff

post.summary: Record a read for analytics. Best-effort; anonymous views count too.
File a moderation report against content or a user.

put.summary: Create or update a review of an entity (one per user per entity).

post.summary:
Submit one anonymized salary data point. Nothing user-identifying is
written — the bucket row only ever carries bounds + count. Sub-threshold
buckets stay unreadable, so even the writer cannot deanonymize.
Submit an anonymized salary data point.

get.summary:
Readable buckets for a role — sub-threshold buckets are absent by design.
Aggregated salary ranges for a role (anonymized, bucketed).

post.summary: Leave feedback on a session. Participants only; one per person.
Request mentorship from a mentor.

put.summary: Block a user. Blocks hide profiles and mute interactions both ways.

delete.summary: Unblock a user.
Cancel a pending connection request.

post.summary:
The TARGET accepts the requester's pending connection.
Accept a connection request.
Reject a connection request.

delete.summary: Unfollow a user.

get.summary:
Fetch a profile. Visibility matrix: public → everyone, connections only,
private → self; blocks hide the profile entirely (404).

get.description:
Auth + membership are checked BEFORE the upgrade — a non-member never
reaches the socket.
Upgrade to the chat websocket for a conversation.

AdminStatusResponse.description: Instance stats for the admin overview.

AdminUserView.description: One row of the admin user directory.

CommentView.description: A single comment in a thread.

CommunityPostRef.description: A post attached to a community.

CommunityView.description: Community card — the list and detail contract.

ConversationRef.description: Minimal conversation reference (create/fetch by other user).

ConversationView.description: A conversation as listed for the caller.

cover_image_url.description:
Cover art URL — optional presentation metadata. Not an inline
resource: readers always load it with `referrerpolicy` + lazy
loading, and the value is opaque to the renderer.

EventDetailResponse.description:
Full event detail: the card fields + speakers and the caller's
registration status (registered / waitlisted / null).

up_to.description: Mark everything up to this id as read. `null` = mark all.

NotificationPreferencesView.description:
The caller's notification preferences — the typed contract for both the
GET and PUT handlers (kills the previous `Value`-shaped responses).

NotificationView.description:
A single notification in the feed, with read state derived from the
per-user cursor (items at or below the cursor are read).

OrgView.description: Organization card — the list and detail contract.

PostListItem.description: A single post in a list page — the feed card contract.

before.description:
Keyset cursor — opaque to clients, emitted as `next_cursor` by the
previous page. Replaces OFFSET, which degrades and duplicates under
concurrent inserts.

body_html.description: Markdown rendered to sanitized HTML server-side (see `keystone_db::markdown`).

cover_image_url.description:
Cover art URL — optional presentation metadata, loaded lazily and
without referrer by the reader.

RelatedPostView.description: A related-reading card: same tag family, ranked by overlap then recency.

ReportView.description: One open report in the staff queue.

SearchHitView.description: One ranked hit across posts, users, communities and courses.

q.description: The raw search string (FTS lexemes + typo fallback).

SearchResponse.description: Search response — ranked hits for a query.

SendMessageResponse.description: Create / send responses carry the new row.

SessionListResponse.description: Wrapper for the sessions list endpoint.

SessionView.description:
One live session as the client sees it. `current` marks the session whose
refresh cookie this browser is holding — never reveal the token itself.

csrf_token.description:
CSRF double-submit token: echoed back in `X-CSRF-Token` on cookie
state-changing requests (refresh/logout).
